title: AIS traffic
description: Ships around the Lesser Antilles from the Flink results. Panels titled 'latest' are anchored on the most recent position received, not on the clock, so they also work on a replay.

panels.title: Ships (latest)
panels.description: Ships seen in the 30 minutes before the latest position, plus ships gone dark in the last 6 hours at their last known position. Red: dark. Orange: impossible jump in the last 30 minutes. Blue: moored or at anchor. Green: under way.

targets.rawSql:
with anchor as (select max(ts) as t from ship_positions),
dark as (
  select mmsi from dark_periods, anchor
  where silent_until is null and silent_from > anchor.t - interval '6 hours'
),
jumped as (
  select mmsi from position_jumps, anchor where to_time > anchor.t - interval '30 minutes'
)
select
  p.mmsi, p.ship_name as name, p.lat as latitude, p.lon as longitude,
  p.sog_kn as speed_kn, p.nav_status, p.port,
  case
    when p.mmsi in (select mmsi from dark) then 'dark'
    when p.mmsi in (select mmsi from jumped) then 'jump'
    when p.nav_status in (1, 5) then 'moored'
    else 'under way'
  end as state
from ship_positions p, anchor
where p.ts > anchor.t - interval '30 minutes' or p.mmsi in (select mmsi from dark)
order by p.mmsi

panels.title: Ships dark now (latest)
panels.description: Open AIS silences that started in the 6 hours before the latest position: no report for more than 15 minutes, and not back yet.

targets.rawSql:
with anchor as (select max(ts) as t from ship_positions)
select
  d.ship_name as ship, d.silent_from,
  round(extract(epoch from anchor.t - d.silent_from) / 60) as minutes_silent
from dark_periods d, anchor
where d.silent_until is null and d.silent_from > anchor.t - interval '6 hours'
order by d.silent_from

panels.title: Impossible jumps (latest)
panels.description: Consecutive positions more than 1 nm apart at an implied speed above 60 knots, in the 30 minutes before the latest position.

targets.rawSql:
with anchor as (select max(ts) as t from ship_positions)
select
  j.to_time as time, j.ship_name as ship,
  round(j.distance_nm::numeric, 1) as distance_nm,
  round(j.implied_speed_kn::numeric) as implied_speed_kn
from position_jumps j, anchor
where j.to_time > anchor.t - interval '30 minutes'
order by j.to_time desc

panels.title: Port arrivals and departures (latest)
panels.description: The last 20 ships entering or leaving a port area.

targets.rawSql:
select event_time as time, ship_name as ship, event, port
from port_events
order by event_time desc
limit 20

panels.title: Ships per port
panels.description: Distinct ships seen in each port area, per 5-minute window (port_activity).

targets.rawSql:
select window_start as time, port as metric, ships as value
from port_activity
where $__timeFilter(window_start)
order by 1
